mechanics.claim: The net deals magic damage only to the first enemy hit, a single-target effect.
mechanics.quote: The net deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: Casting the net causes Caitlyn to recoil (dash) 390 units backward, which does not affect damage output directly but can delay buffered actions.
mechanics.quote: recoils 390 units in the opposite direction

mechanics.claim: If Caitlyn buffers an ability or basic attack during the cast time, it starts only after the recoil dash ends, delaying the next damage instance.
mechanics.quote: If '''Caitlyn''' buffers an ability or [[basic attack]] during this ability's cast time, the buffered ability or basic attack will instead start after the dash ends.

mechanics.claim: Other abilities can be cast during the recoil dash if input after the cast time, allowing damage abilities to fire without waiting for the dash to finish.
mechanics.quote: Other abilities can be cast while {{tip|dash|dashing}} if they are input after the cast time.

mechanics.claim: The net's missile can fail to fire (and thus deal no damage) if Caitlyn is suppressed during the cast time.
mechanics.quote: ''90 Caliber Net's'' missile will fail to fire if '''Caitlyn''' is {{tip|suppression|suppressed}} during the cast time.
